falsifier: Execution-level: the hypothesis is falsified if, under matched saved priors, streams, checkpoint and native protocol, the O-region run shows no paired change in U_tau or mean_all_pic50 versus S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY beyond the descriptive paired-pool spread, or if the observed change is reproduced equally by a non-O region change on the same prior pool, which would support explanation (b) over (a). Terminal consequence: affinity is evaluated first using the frozen definitions, with structural and energy side effects reported separately; improved similarity, role retention, or lower loss alone cannot establish affinity improvement. A numerical no-op or interface failure is labeled separately from a scientific negative result.
operator_definition: Implemented and derivative-tested: local Hungarian assignment, robust per-point distance to observed teacher coordinates. Units A; no chemical-role or energy assumption.

scientific_rationale: Single registered change versus parent R15_v2: region_id F_b011_s030__reference -> F_b011_s030__O, with atom_slots narrowed to the O-region support [1,16,18,19] (C,O,C,O per F_b011_s030__NO/regional_context support). Operator, controller (unit_rms), dose, window [0.1,0.5], steps 100, teacher_time 0.5, representation bridge, and free chemical graphs are unchanged. The pointwise operator is the smallest implemented term that tests the hypothesis: it matches generated points to teacher ligand coordinates by local Hungarian assignment and applies a robust per-point distance, so changing the region changes which teacher coordinates are matched and the realized local displacement. No type, affinity, orientation, or categorical-logit gradient is enabled; assignment_element_cost remains a detached correspondence cost, not a direct elemental force. The discriminating observable is the paired from-zero tail utility U_tau and mean_all_pic50 of the O-region run against S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY under matched saved priors, streams, checkpoint and native protocol, together with measured point_rms_A and target_error_mean. Source layout score 8.704859 (F_b011_s030__O/conditional_layout) is a fixed-geometry legal-layout input, not a generated-score forecast or coordinate-intervention effect. Prior region changes on this reused prior pool were heterogeneous and mostly lower-tail than reference (campaign/experiment_families: pointwise/fixed, 10 conditions, 6 regions, 9 lower tail), so they do not establish a universal region effect; the O-region change is a distinct condition whose informativeness rests on the conditional difference in local support.
